meta.notes: A worldgen/world_preset tag gives one name to several worldgen/world_preset ids. values lists ids or other tags (written #namespace:path); set replace to true only to wipe what other packs put in a tag of the same id. Only presets in the vanilla tag #minecraft:normal appear on the World Type button; a tag of your own such as #msm_examples:my_presets is for grouping and reuse.
